# clavis admin rotate-root-key

<p class="cli-lead">Initialise or rotate the instance root key while the server is stopped</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis admin rotate-root-key [flags]
```

</div>

Create (`--init`) or rotate the root key while the server is stopped.
Every organization key and TOTP secret is re-encrypted, and the old key
is backed up.

## Examples

```sh
clavis admin rotate-root-key --init
clavis admin rotate-root-key --yes
clavis admin rotate-root-key --config /etc/clavis/clavis.yaml
```
